title: Review-qualified goal closure
description: Objective: close J1's remaining evidence-authority gap: goal.close currently trusts opaque caller-supplied verification/review witness refs. Deliverable: a daemon prerequisite composer that reads the exact durable EvidenceReceipt and ReviewOutputAccepted records for the candidate/result, binds their hashes and zero-authority proof into the core closure witness, and only then invokes the existing goal reducer/commit path. NOT in scope: new core rules, review-round persistence, verifier execution, UI, or canary tests. Depends on Durable verification receipt dispatch and the landed review persistence task task-9011e3b32c414e9ca0d49f49fdfaaf08. Owned paths: apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-services.ts, goal-services.test.ts, a focused goal-qualification.ts module, and apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-ledger.ts refusal vocabulary if required. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: goal.close derives its verification, review, result, and zero-authority witnesses from matching durable production records; request payload refs/truth labels alone cannot satisfy closure.

Missing receipt, non-passing/UNKNOWN receipt, mismatched result hash, absent ReviewOutputAccepted, stale review package, or remaining authority each refuse with a distinct stable daemon-prerequisite code/layer and commit nothing.
A fully matching verified/reviewed result closes the goal through the existing core reducer in the third J1 human action; no extra human command is introduced.
Replay is idempotent with one durable closure row, and earlier review/evidence records remain readable and byte-identical.
Focused daemon and repo typecheck gates exit 0; the worker mutation-drills the durable read rather than a request-field check.
taskRails: TDD every behavior change; every refusal test pins the exact stable reason code and refusing layer, and generated sweeps assert a positive case count.
Use only public package roots across package boundaries; no deep imports, test-owned authority, mock-backed acceptance, or optimistic UNKNOWN upgrades.
Keep production files focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; stage and commit only explicit owned paths.

2. `ls apps/daemon/src/evidence/` -> DIRECTORY ABSENT. That is task-44d4873e's owned path; it has landed nothing.

Caution for whoever plans this next - it is EMITTED as an event and nothing looks it up, so the closure composer needs a read path for the accepted-output record too; that may itself need a prerequisite.

The gap this task describes IS real and worth doing: apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-services.ts (114 lines) takes closureWitness and zeroAuthorityWitness straight off request.payload with no durable check.

WHY NOT PLAN NOW: writing receipt persistence here would duplicate task-44d4873e's owned files in the shared worktree, and the only other routes - a narrowed DoD or a mock-backed journey - are both forbidden by the project rails.

GOVERNOR: unblock once task-44d4873e is DONE and apps/daemon/src/evidence/ carries a receipt read model.
